            "class": "AsBuiltJoint",
            "doc": "\nRedefines the relationship between the two joint geometries as a rigid joint.\nTo use this method, you need to position the timeline marker to immediately before this as-built joint.\nThis can be accomplished using the following code: thisAsBuiltJoint.timelineObject.rollTo(True)\nReturns true if successful.\n",
            "name": "setAsRigidJointMotion",
            "namespace": "adsk.fusion",
            "signature": "() -> bool",
            "type": "function"
        },
        {
            "class": "AsBuiltJointInput",
            "doc": "\nDefines the relationship between the two joint geometries as a rigid joint.\nReturns true if successful.\n",
            "name": "setAsRigidJointMotion",
            "namespace": "adsk.fusion",
            "signature": "() -> bool",
            "type": "function"
        },
        {
            "class": "ConstructionPlaneInput",
            "doc": "\nThis input method is for creating a construction plane that is offset from a planar\nface or construction plane at a specified distance. This can result in\na parametric or non-parametric construction plane depending on whether the parent\ncomponent is parametric or is a direct edit component.\nplanarEntity : A plane, planar face or construction plane from which to create the offset plane.\noffset : ValueInput object that specifies the offset distance for the plane.\nReturns true if the construction plane definition is successful.\n",
            "name": "setByOffset",
            "namespace": "adsk.fusion",
            "signature": "(planarEntity: Base, offset: ValueInput) -> bool",
            "type": "function"
        },
        {
            "class": "ExportManager",
            "doc": "\nCreates an STEPExportOptions object that's used to export a design in STEP format. Creation\nof the STEPExportOptions object does not perform the export. You must pass this object to the\nExportManager.execute method to perform the export. The STEPExportOptions supports any available\noptions when exporting to STEP format.\nfilename : The filename of the STEP file to be created.\ngeometry : The geometry to export. Valid geometry for this is currently a Component object. This argument is optional\nand if not specified, it results in the root component and it entire contents being exported.\nThe created STEPExportOptions object or null if the creation failed.\n",
            "name": "createSTEPExportOptions",
            "namespace": "adsk.fusion",
            "signature": "(*args) -> adsk.fusion.STEPExportOptions",
            "type": "function"
        },
        {
            "class": "ExportManager",
            "doc": "\nCreates an FusionArchiveExportOptions object that's used to export a design in Fusion archive format. Creation\nof the FusionArchiveExportOptions object does not perform the export. You must pass this object to the\nExportManager.execute method to perform the export. The FusionArchiveExportOptions supports any available\noptions when exporting to Fusion archive format.\nfilename : The filename of the Fusion archive file to be created.\ngeometry : The geometry to export. Valid geometry for this is currently a Component object. This argument is optional\nand if not specified, it results in the root component and it entire contents being exported.\nThe created FusionArchiveExportOptions object or null if the creation failed.\n",
            "name": "createFusionArchiveExportOptions",
            "namespace": "adsk.fusion",
            "signature": "(*args) -> adsk.fusion.FusionArchiveExportOptions",
            "type": "function"
        }
    ],
